actual: Exact-set verifier, four production-path negative fixtures, locked offline build and zero-mutation admission passed.

procedure: A live gpui::Window raw-window-handle was validated and observed by a borrowed, generation-fenced SuperDesktop subclass.
expected: PID, thread, session, GPUI WindowId and generation identify the same GPUI-owned HWND; the bridge creates and destroys no HWND.
actual: Semantic verifier passed exact identity and ownership fields with bridge_created_hwnd=false and bridge_destroyed_hwnd=false.

procedure: The subclass copied DPI/RECT, display and activation payloads into fixed owned slots before DefSubclassProc forwarding.
expected: Owned values are DPI 96x96 with 320x180 RECT, display 32bpp 320x180 and activation state 1; no raw pointer survives.
actual: Trace semantic verification and payload-mutation fixture passed; bridge unit test proved RECT lifetime independence.

procedure: Closing fenced late adapter work and waited for unordered GPUI on_window_closed plus WM_NCDESTROY before finalization.
expected: Finalized follows both terminal signals, raw callback state is released exactly once, HWND is retired and no fatal callback occurs.
actual: on_window_closed sequence 3, WM_NCDESTROY 4, finalized 5, outstanding 0, late fence true and fatal null.

expected: Only the controlled HWND is mutated and AppBar removal succeeds.
actual: Trace v2 controlled_only=true, appbar_registered=true, reserved rect recorded, and first removal succeeded.

procedure: SPI_GETWORKAREA snapshots were compared after normal and injected-failure teardown.

procedure: A process-owned helper produced true Shell Hook events before deregistration and another helper tested the post-unregister fence.

procedure: Typed failure was injected after ABM_NEW/reserve but before Shell Hook registration, then the normal hook-first teardown path ran twice.
expected: First teardown reverses the mutation; second teardown is a no-op; work area and resources exactly restore.
actual: Typed stage matched, AppBar removed, second teardown false/false, and 163/2/9 restored exactly.

procedure: After one unaccepted full-lifecycle warm-up, two measured lifecycles and one mid-failure lifecycle recorded work-area and process/USER/GDI snapshots with source/binary/substrate/admission hashes.
expected: Each measured lifecycle independently returns to its own baseline and evidence inputs are hash-bound.
actual: Measured #1 and #2 each remained 163/2/9; binary AD086F..., runner C03D66..., adapter 8CDF7E...; Explorer mutation and takeover flags false.

procedure: The runner and capture host established and verified PerMonitorV2 before querying real monitor geometry and DPI, then performed two stable refreshes.
expected: Identity and physical coordinate geometry remain stable and non-virtualized with positive per-monitor DPI.
actual: DISPLAY1 remained 3840x2160 with 3840x2018 work area and 168x168 DPI; thread awareness equality passed.

procedure: An isolated virtual topology adapter emitted add, remove, primary and DPI transitions with explicit device payloads.
expected: All four transition classes are present and the fixture cannot be represented as physical mixed-DPI evidence.
actual: Strict verifier accepted the exact four transitions and physical_mixed_dpi_claimed=false; mutation fixture was rejected.

procedure: The current ExplorerPatcher taskbar host was observed read-only and its invocation path was evaluated against the trusted-contract requirement.
expected: An untrusted invocation ABI yields a typed stop without sending a message or invoking Start.
actual: Shell_TrayWnd was observed; invocation_attempted=false and typed disposition remained stop, so G-TASKBAR is not passed.

procedure: Injected missing-host and untrusted-host fixtures exercised the same typed probe result path without touching the live taskbar.
expected: Both cases return distinct typed unavailable results and never attempt invocation.
actual: Both fixtures passed and the independent reviewer confirmed the truthful G-TASKBAR stop.

procedure: Capture bracketed the capability runner with external Explorer, AppBar and work-area snapshots and recorded process/USER/GDI counters plus all source, binary, admission and substrate hashes.
expected: External state and resources exactly restore, with no Explorer mutation, Shell takeover or Start invocation.
actual: External snapshots matched, resources remained 85/1/0, and strict plus seven negative semantic cases passed.
